title: Replace character scene frame
description: Creates one reviewable scene image from a video frame and two intact character references. No reference segmentation or video generation. Approval is a separate action.

requirements.instructions: Install the exact Qwen Image 2.1 INT8 ConvRot diffusion file and verify its SHA-256. The Qwen Research License restricts use to non-commercial research or evaluation unless a separate commercial license is obtained.

evidence: Static-only scene candidate using the installed Qwen Image 2.1 edit workflow. All reference pixels are passed as image inputs; no SAM, reference mask or subject crop. Output requires human review; execution does not establish likeness.
